card.summary: The Marine Aquaculture Research for America Act of 2026 (MARA Act of 2026) directs the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) to establish an Office of Aquaculture and an assessment program for commercial-scale offshore aquaculture demonstration projects. The bill outlines criteria for issuing, renewing, modifying, or terminating permits for offshore aquaculture facilities in federal waters (the exclusive economic zone), creates a unified federal permitting and review process, provides general support and technical assistance for the aquaculture industry, and mandates specific scientific studies and reports from the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine and the Government Accountability Office.
